context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: ごちそう/居眠り/ばったり/噴水/観賞/トランペット/ガッカリ/折りたたみ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、今日は、本気で、絶対、ごちそう、絶対、ママ、絶対、作ったよ
lines.en: Sho, today I made you a real feast — I mean it, I really went all out.
lines.style: Warm, bright opening. Eager to share something she's proud of. Light lift on 'made' — almost conspiratorial, like she's been planning this. Even pace, gentle emphasis.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、ソファで、絶対、居眠り、絶対、してるよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad's napping on the sofa right now, seriously.
lines.style: Small, observant delivery. Not complaining, just noticing. Slight amusement underneath — he does this every time. Clear-eyed, matter-of-fact tone of a six-year-old reporting fact.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日、本気で、絶対、駅前で、絶対、ばったり、絶対、お祖母ちゃんに、絶対、会ったよ
lines.en: Today I ran into Grandma by the station — just completely by accident.
lines.style: Reflective, almost marveling. Warm remembering tone. Slight pause before 'by accident' — like she's still a little surprised it happened. Soft, easy pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、噴水、絶対、ぼく、絶対、見たいな
lines.en: Mom, I really want to see the fountain in the park.
lines.style: Bright, direct request. Hopeful but not whiny. Simple urgency — the thing he wants is clear and present in his mind. Short, eager sentences.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お花の、絶対、観賞、絶対、お庭で、絶対、楽しんでるわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, Grandpa's really enjoying himself looking at the flowers in the garden.
lines.style: Tender observation. Gentle pace, almost protective tone — she's noticing something good and sharing it. Slight warmth on 'enjoying himself.' Trails softly with his name at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、トランペット、絶対、習いたいな、ママ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to learn trumpet.
lines.style: Clear, sincere request. This isn't a passing whim — there's conviction underneath the lightness. Straightforward, earnest six-year-old honesty. Held slightly at the end, like he's thinking about it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お弁当を、本気で、絶対、忘れて、絶対、ガッカリ、絶対、しないようにね、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, don't forget your lunchbox — I don't want you disappointed at school.
lines.style: Gentle reminder, practical but not stern. Caring directness — she's thinking ahead for him. Warm, low stakes. The kind of thing she says not because he forgets but because she notices.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、折りたたみ、絶対、傘、絶対、ぼく、絶対、持ってるよ
lines.en: Mom, I have a new folding umbrella now — see?
lines.style: Small pride in his voice. Showing something off he's pleased about. Quick, bright delivery. Slight lift at the end — inviting her to notice what he's noticing. Childlike genuine.
